title: From Geometry to Behavior: How Instruction Exposure Unlocks Latent Rhetorical Directions in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.37685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models do not merely memorize facts; they absorb rhetorical strategies from pretraining data, including the human tendency to reason by analogy. We ask: is this absorbed capability geometrically accessible before any instruction tuning, and what determines whether it can be activated at inference time?   We extract an "Analogy Vector" from the residual stream via difference-in-means and show it enables steerable explanation style across seven instruction-tuned models (Gemma-2, Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5; 2B-32B), improving harmonic mean from 3.22 to 3.94 (+22%) for Gemma-2-9B-IT on 300 held-out test prompts. A small human validation study confirms the LLM judge on Analogy Quality.   Our central finding, from seven matched base-instruct pairs, is a gradient of behavioral accessibility: the analogy direction exists in every base model, but its behavioral accessibility under linear intervention scales continuously with instruction expos

translated_title: 从几何到行为：指令暴露如何解锁大语言模型中潜在的修辞方向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.37685v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：语言模型不仅仅记忆事实；它们还从预训练数据中吸收修辞策略，包括人类通过类比进行推理的倾向。我们提出的问题是：这种被吸收的能力在指令微调之前是否在几何上是可访问的，以及是什么决定了它在推理时能否被激活？我们通过均值差方法从残差流中提取出一个“类比向量”，并证明该向量能够在七个指令微调模型上实现可控的解释风格，在300个保留测试提示上，Gemma-2-9B-IT的调和平均值从3.22提升至3.94（+22%）。一项小规模人类验证研究证实了LLM裁判在类比质量评估上的可靠性。我们的核心发现来自七个匹配的基础-指令模型对，揭示了一种行为可及性的梯度：类比方向存在于每个基础模型中，但其在线性干预下的行为可及性随指令暴露程度连续增长（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现类比推理的修辞方向以几何形式存在于所有基础模型中，但其能否在推理时被激活取决于指令微调的暴露程度，通过提取“类比向量”可实现跨模型的可控解释风格干预。
